ab: Survive a fatal hit above 40% HP: health set to 200, stamina to 50, 10s immunity (can't deal damage). 5 min cooldown.
Only able to eat the freshest of meat, meager leftovers will not do.
Able to jump again mid-air. Only usable for the first 2 seconds after leaving the ground.
Gain 200% increased armor for 5 seconds. Must be latched to activate. Buff is decaying over time.
Non-group creatures within 20m broadcast a call. Group within 100m: +20% trot speed for 30s, ends in combat.
Can eat noxious meat, fish, carrion, and bones. Who needs the 5 second rule if it's still perfectly edible?
Latched: applies freshly baked (+20% stamina and health recovery, 30s), kept after unlatching. Works grouped or not.
Latched onto non-group creature: -10% armor per stack, steady venom, poison and toxin. Up to 2 stacks.
Latch onto a creature to use attacks and abilities. Jump or run out of stamina to release. 50% less damage.
Three combat voice calls: Call to Maul, Call Of The Clan, and Blaring Yowl.
Apply a 25% attack damage increase for all group members within 30 meters for 90 seconds.
Apply a 25% armor increase for all group members within 30 meters for 90 seconds.
All enemies within 30 meters deal 25% reduced damage for 90 seconds.
Increases jump height and decreases fall damage.
+30% bucking resistance. Low on health: greatly boosted health recovery until healed to 25%.
A call that increases all group members armor by 25% within 50 meters. Lasts until you are hit.
Resting or sleeping within 10m boosts healing by 180% for you and group members. No effect in combat.
Latched foes gain fleas (max 10, faster over time). Each: -5% HP/stamina regen, -2.5% bleed heal, +50% food/water drain.
Enemies within 10m: -15% attack damage for 25s per hairball, max 2 stacks. At 2 stacks, immune to hairballs for 5 min.
Three healing voice calls: Soothing Purrs, Sunbather, and Ancestral Cry.
Bask in sunlight to raise your healing rate by 10x for 60 seconds. Healing only works during the day.
Purr to boost healing rate of party members within 30m for 120s. Must be in a group to use.
All group members within 30 meters heal status effects twice as quickly for 30 seconds. Can be used solo.
Reduces all incoming damage to yourself by 60% for 60 seconds.
Increases attack damage by 10% for all group members within 30 meters for 25 seconds.
Latched: -12.5% ability cooldowns and -10% stamina cost on the target, up to 4 stacks. Affects grouped and ungrouped.
Ignore uphill movement decrease, increases speed when moving downhill by 10%, and reduces falling damage by 10%.
After crouching 10s, sprint for a 50% speed boost lasting 10s. Out of combat only; ends on entering combat.
Three survival voice calls: Swift Tracks, Queen's Guidance, and Enduring Hunger.
A call that increases your group's trotting speed by 20% for 5 minutes within 75 meters.
Group within 75m takes only 10% incoming damage for 2 min, but deals no damage meanwhile.
All group members within 75 meters receive 30% slower food and water drain for 5 minutes.
Ungrouped: more stamina recovery. Grouped: you and felines within 50m gain 10% stamina recovery, up to 4 stacks.
Activate for a quick forward boost of speed.
